name: Chatroom Comfort
source:
One night, you enter an online chatroom to find that someone is going through a tough time. As you comfort them, you'll discover that a little kindness goes a long way.

[From [url=https://nookstray.itch.io/chatroom-comfort]Itch.io[/url]]
